notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024!
notes.content:
System Purge: Hollow Point is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024!

We’re thrilled to announce that System Purge: Hollow Point will be part of TGAGWCAGA 2024, or The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards - a one of a kind indie game showcase streaming this Friday, December 13th!

TGAGWCAGA is a brand new showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Subscribe to TGAGWCAGA's Youtube to watch!

TGAGWCAGA 2024
Friday, December 13th 
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
Watch the stream here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA]https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA[/url]

We'll also be part of the Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring tons of amazing indie games, including ours.

Make sure to join us this Friday, tell your friends and wishlist your favorite titles!

notes.title: New Demo Area - Replicant Labs
notes.content:

notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point Demo Update
notes.content:
System Purge: Hollow Point demo has been updated with a few quality of life improvements. Some of these changes are due to feedback from the community. Thank you for your support!

- updated obstacles
- lighting changes
- pulsar wave frequency reduced

notes.title: System Purge: Hollow Point Demo Available Now
notes.content:
The System Purge: Hollow Point Demo is available now during the PixElated Festival Steam Event that will be running July 29th - August 5th. 

PixElated is a digital festival celebrating beautiful pixel art games. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems, this event will showcase a selection of Adventure and RPG pixel-art games all in one place!

[url=https://www.braveatnight.co.uk/pixelatedfest]https://www.braveatnight.co.uk/pixelatedfest[/url]

July 29th - August 5th
[list]
[*] System Purge: Hollow Point Demo will be live during the event.
[*] Actual Nerds will be actively monitoring your feedback in the Steam Community Forums, come talk with us about the demo!
[*] System Purge Director Jacob Vanbendegon will be participating in the PixElated Festival AMA
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the demo, and please consider wishlisting if you do - we appreciate your support!
